steps.title: Choose the tabs to keep
steps.caption: Select web tabs in your current window. Click a title to switch to it.

steps.title: Give the burrow a name
steps.caption: This demo keeps the tabs open. Closing them after saving is optional.

steps.title: Saved safely on this device
steps.caption: TabBunny saves the selected links and removes duplicate URLs.

steps.caption: Expand a burrow to inspect its links before reopening it.

steps.title: Hop back into the project
steps.caption: Open burrow restores its saved links in a new window.

steps.title: Keep a portable backup
steps.caption: Export backup downloads JSON. Import backup restores valid collections.
